title: Full Time Permanent Work From Home - Customer Support and Sales
description:
Permanent Work From Home | Domestic Process | Healthcare Diagnostics 
 We are an authorised all-India sales partner for Thyrocare, India's largest diagnostic lab. This is a permanent work-from-home role no office visits, no relocation, open to candidates in any city in India. 
 Please read the schedule carefully before applying. 
 This role is 6 days a week, 10 hours a day, on rotational shifts. If that doesn't suit you, this is not the right role and we'd rather you know now. 
 Shift timings (rotational, assigned as per business requirement): 7:00 AM 5:00 PM 9:00 AM 7:00 PM 12:00 PM 10:00 PM One weekly off, on a rotational day, communicated in advance. Weekends are working days. 
 Role & responsibilities Handle customer queries on call and WhatsApp and convert them into confirmed bookings this is a sales-led support role, not a query-closing desk. Understand each customer's requirements in detail and recommend the right health checkup package as per the pre-defined SOPs only. Own every customer end to end — from first enquiry to order booking to sample collection to final report delivery. No handoffs, no dropped threads. Follow the process exactly as documented. Ask when information is missing rather than assuming. Maintain accurate order and customer records. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Minimum 1 year of voice-based customer support or tele sales experience. Freshers please do not apply. Fluent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi . Ability to understand what a customer actually needs, not just what they ask for. Comfortable with Excel, Word, WhatsApp and email. Good negotiation skills. Own laptop in excellent working condition, wired broadband connection, and power backup covering laptop and router for the full shift. A dedicated workspace at home with zero background noise and zero interruptions. Candidates with a career gap, and women returning to work after a break, are welcome to apply. 
 Salary & benefits Fixed: 18,000 – 23,000 per month in hand , based on English fluency and relevant experience. Monthly performance incentive: up to 10,000 . Loyalty bonus: 6,000 on completion of every 6 months. Realistic earning potential: 25,000 – 30,000 per month. Salary credited to your bank account every month. Detailed hands-on training provided. This is a permanent role and we are looking for people who want to stay and grow with us. 
 How to apply 
 Apply through Naukri, or email your CV to thyrocare@live.com or thyromail@gmail.com . 
 In your email or Naukri message, mention: (1) your Laptop RAM, (2) your power backup arrangement. Applications without these details will not be shortlisted.

description:
Farmiti Agritech Pvt Ltd is a growing India-based technology-enabled business working in Honey, Spices and Natural Food Products , serving both domestic and international markets. Through our business, we work with B2B buyers, distributors, wholesalers, importers and private-label brands and provide solutions including bulk products, private labeling, packaging and brand launch support. We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented B2B Sales & Business Development Executive who can help us grow our customer base across both Domestic and Export markets . Role & Responsibilities Generate and qualify new B2B leads through Phone, WhatsApp, Email, LinkedIn and other channels. Identify potential domestic and international buyers, importers, distributors, wholesalers and private-label businesses. Handle the complete sales process from lead generation follow-up quotation negotiation order closing . Develop and maintain long-term relationships with customers. Handle enquiries for Honey, Spices, Bulk Supply and Private Label products . Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products and solutions. Share product details, company profile, pricing and quotations with potential buyers. Follow up consistently with prospects and existing customers. Candidate Requirements: Fluent Bengali, Hindi, English communication is mandatory. Good spoken and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and negotiation skills. Experience in B2B Sales / Business Development / FMCG / Food Products / Export Sales will be preferred. Comfortable communicating with customers through Phone, WhatsApp, Email and LinkedIn. Basic practical knowledge of Digital Presence and E-commerce . Ability to work independently and manage leads effectively. Target-oriented and self-motivated. Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets. Comfortable handling both Domestic and International customers . Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in B2B sales may also be considered. Work Mode: Currently Work From Home (WFH). As the business grows, the role may transition to an office-based position in Kolkata . Candidates should be comfortable with this future transition. Compensation: 20,000 Fixed Salary per month + Performance-Based Sales Incentives Your earning potential will increase with your sales performance. Who We Are Looking For: We are looking for someone who is not just interested in making calls, but wants to build relationships, generate business and close sales . If you are confident in speaking with customers, good at follow-ups and interested in working across both Domestic and International B2B markets , we would like to hear from you.

 About the Role 
 LEADSOURCE TECH is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager Maharashtra to develop and grow our business across the state, with a strong focus on Mumbai and Pune. 
 We are specifically looking for someone who understands B2B sales in the Indian market and has experience selling services, technology solutions or other B2B offerings to Indian companies. 
 This is not a purely inside-sales or international lead-generation role . The role requires someone who is equally comfortable prospecting for new business, speaking with decision-makers, visiting customers, attending industry events, building relationships and taking opportunities forward towards closure. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own business development and sales activities for Maharashtra , with primary focus on Mumbai and Pune. Identify and develop new business opportunities across IT and non-IT sectors . Build relationships with business owners, CXOs, IT leaders, functional heads and other key decision-makers. Generate opportunities through field visits, calling, networking, referrals, LinkedIn, exhibitions and industry events . Conduct face-to-face customer meetings to understand business requirements and identify potential technology opportunities. Present LEADSOURCE TECH's capabilities across custom software development, AI, process automation, system integration and digital transformation . Work closely with technical and delivery teams for solution discussions, proposals and customer presentations. Manage opportunities from initial prospecting through meetings, follow-ups, proposals, commercial discussions and closure. Develop long-term customer relationships and identify opportunities for repeat and referral business. Maintain an active sales pipeline and provide regular updates on opportunities, customer discussions and expected closures. Work towards defined sales and revenue targets . Travel within Maharashtra as required for customer meetings, networking and business development. 
 What We're Looking For 
 Minimum 4 years of B2B sales/business development experience. Proven experience selling to Indian companies in the Indian market . Experience combining field sales with direct prospecting and relationship-based selling . Strong understanding of the Maharashtra business environment, particularly Mumbai and Pune . Fluency in Marathi is mandatory , along with good Hindi and English communication. Comfortable independently approaching and meeting new customers. Experience interacting with business owners, senior management and corporate decision-makers. Ability to understand a customer's business problem and connect it with an appropriate technology or service solution. Experience managing opportunities beyond lead generation, including customer meetings, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations and closure. Willingness to travel across Maharashtra as required. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Candidates with experience selling any of the following will have an advantage: 
 IT Services | Custom Software Development | SaaS | ERP | Business Applications | AI & Automation | Digital Transformation | System Integration | Technology Consulting | Other B2B Professional Services 
 Experience selling to industries such as manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, laboratories, engineering, logistics, retail, professional services or other Indian enterprises/SMEs would also be valuable. 
 Important 
 This position is intended for candidates with Indian domestic B2B sales experience . Candidates whose experience has primarily been limited to US/UK/international inside sales, appointment setting, email outreach or lead qualification , without meaningful experience selling directly to Indian businesses, may not be suitable for this role. 
 About LEADSOURCE TECH 
 LEADSOURCE TECH works with businesses to solve operational and technology challenges through custom software development, AI, process automation, system integration and digital transformation . Engineering Clarity. Delivering Impact.

 The Role in One Line The TSM owns each online lead end-to-end: Connect Persuade Tour Convert. Custodian of the lead from the first call to the signed seat. Work is judged directly by what Zoho CRM shows. 
 What Makes This Role Different You are the custodian of every lead. Each online lead assigned to you is yours to move through the full journey nobody else owns it. Purely online. You sell only to inbound online leads. You do not work with brokers or channel partners 100% of your conversions come from leads. End-to-end. You connect, persuade, drive the tour, and close yourself you are a closer, not just a caller. The CRM is your scoreboard. Your performance is measured entirely on what you record and deliver in Zoho CRM. 
 Key Responsibilities Connect fast: Call every assigned online lead within 30 minutes and keep attempting until reached speed is our biggest advantage. Qualify & persuade: Understand the seat requirement, budget, location and timeline; build interest and handle objections. Drive the tour: Schedule and ensure the site visit happens, coordinating with the Community / Centre team, and follow through. Convert: Present commercials, negotiate within approved limits, and close the seat. Own the CRM: Log every attempt, connect, tour and closure in Zoho so the CRM reflects your true performance no lead left un-updated. Coordinate across teams: Work with Community, Operations and Finance for tours, onboarding and agreements. Know the market: Stay current on competing coworking brands and pricing and pitch the IA Spaces edge. Hit the target: Deliver your monthly seat target of 50 seats and maintain an accurate, healthy pipeline. 
 Must-Have Skill Language Skills: Fluent in Hindi and English (spoken) able to build rapport and sell over the phone in both. Persuasion & Negotiation: Moves a lead from interest to signed handles objections and negotiates commercials confidently within approved limits. Interdepartmental Coordination: Works smoothly with Community / Centre Managers for tours and with Ops & Finance for onboarding and agreements. Competition Knowledge: Knows the competing coworking brands, pricing and positioning and can clearly pitch the IA Spaces advantage. CRM Management: Disciplined in Zoho CRM – every lead, call and stage updated accurately, so the CRM is the true record of performance. 
 Experience & Eligibility Experience: 1–4 years in tele-sales / inside sales with a proven record of personally closing deals over the phone (real estate, coworking, ed-tech, insurance, BFSI or similar). Target orientation: Self-driven and comfortable being measured on the Attempted Connected Tours Closures funnel. 
 What We Offer Paid training: 15-day structured onboarding on the coworking industry and IA Spaces products, pricing & process before you go live. Support to close: Community / Centre teams support you on the ground so you can focus on selling. Real earning upside: Fixed salary plus incentive beyond 50 seats on every seat you close. Growth path: This is a pilot team – strong performers grow into senior sales / team-lead roles as we scale the tele-sales function. 
 Working Details Working hours: 9 hours/day; 6-day work week.
